translation: Barashe na ihema ry'amatungo, bakuramo intorengo — canditse uko nyacyo: Nuko barashe na hemi z'amatungo, bafata ibihumbi by'intare... uko nyacyo: barashe na ihema z'amatungo, bataruye intare z'ahari n'ingamiya, cyaragezwe i Yerushalayimu: Barashe na ⟨?⟩ — andika uko nyacyo: Barashe na ihema z'amatungo, bakurwamo intare nyinshi n'ingamiya, maze bagasubira i Yerushalayimu.
